verdict.rationale: Otter is a SaaS product with a public API, so publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. The evidence never mentions an llms.txt file or docs written for agents. The only API documentation is a single prose help-center article with no machine-readable spec (the openapi.json URL returns 404), and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
